description.translate: Twelve sheets of paper, one final job. I will copy the assembly references and restore the workshop shelves. Voss keeps one set; I keep another. We are not losing the same knowledge twice. Hand the materials to me one at a time.
The old safety ledger names Captain Edda Thorne as a witness to the Concord's last preparations. Find her. Ask what she saw before you ask what she guards. Tell her Mara kept the ledger.
